text:
marie: Heads-up — we're rolling route-policy v3 in Console next week. This adds per-tenant quota buckets and a sampling flag. Want to confirm SDK behavior.

sam: which sampling flag? the telemetry one that toggles path-level sampling? :thinking_face:

marie: yep. `x-route-policy: v3` + `x-sample-mode: path-aware` header. Console will set it for canary tenants.

rafael: impl note: for legacy SDKs we currently drop unknown headers. So we'll lose the sample hint unless SDKs pass through unknown route headers.

priya: ah — that's the break we hit last time. We should decide: 1) pass-through any header starting with `x-route-` in SDKs, or 2) add explicit mapping in each SDK object.

chris: option 1 feels safer short-term. Low risk change in client libs: forward unknown `x-route-*` from user request. But need telemetry opt-in.

elena: strong +1 for pass-through but add a warning log when an unknown header is forwarded. Also ensure we dont send internal secrets.

marie: security check: we must sanitize any header that might contain tokens. We only allow alphanum + `-_/` in header values for forwarded ones.

rafael: can we add a toggle in console rollouts? i.e., server-side canary set `sdk-forward-route-headers: true` so old clients don't forward unexpectedly.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: console/rollout/route-policy-v3 -> canary group=internal-dev Wednesday 10:00 UTC

sam: SDK exposure: Python and TS can add opt-in flag `forward_route_headers=True` default False for now. Go gets `ForwardRouteHeaders` in client opts. We'll flip default after 2 weeks.

priya: also telemetry: if forwarded header contains `x-sample-mode`, we should surface metric `sdk.forwarded_route_sample=true` so console can validate behavior.

dan: small nit: the Python `Client` already has `headers_whitelist`. Maybe instead add pattern support and `headers_whitelist_patterns=["^x-route-.*"]` behind a feature flag.

elena: agreed. What about older pinned versions? We'll need a brief advisory to customers: "If you rely on server-side sampling hints, upgrade SDK or enable passthrough in proxy".

marie: plan: 1) implement pass-through opt-in in all SDKs (PRs by EOD), 2) Console rollout with canary flag, 3) monitor `sdk.forwarded_route_sample` and `console.sample_applied` dashboards, 4) flip default after 2 weeks if stable.

sam: PR checklist: unit test for header whitelist pattern, integration test with local console canary, changelog note, and a deprecation warning in logs for old behavior.

rafael: I'll draft the console dashboard panel mapping to show headers seen + sample rate. Will post dashboard link once created.

marie: thanks — please tag me on PRs. If anyone sees a privacy concern ping security@. 

priya: ACK. I'll coordinate TS + Py releases and the opt-in feature flag gating.

chris: timeline ok. I'll handle Go client.

dan: documenting customer advisory now.

marie: great — meeting free for follow-up Thursday 15:00 UTC. :calendar:
